description.value: Bray's is a West Coast tapas restaurant and wine bar rooted in the Bray family's multi-generational history in Victoria, dating back to Richard Bray's arrival in 1882. The menu celebrates local BC produce and seafood through family-style sharing plates, with an extensive wine list spanning local vineyards and international wineries. It occupies a cozy yet contemporary space in downtown Victoria, making it a solid post-ride dining option in the heart of the city.
